alternative_explanations: A fixed four-action hypothesis library may carry nearly all algorithmic structure, reducing learning to symbol grounding.
The hard-versus-dense cost gap may be predetermined entirely by a hand-provided address index rather than learned routing.
Supplying the ordered opaque program tokens tests execution of a new composition, not autonomous program synthesis.
confounds: The benchmark is a visible synthetic micro-world with explicit addresses, no perception or language, one quick seed and operation counts defined by the harness.
K adds dormant cells while active program length stays fixed; this isolates irrelevant-memory scaling but not growing relevant working sets.
falsification_criteria: Kill this learned-hard implementation if any held-out composition or adversarial cell is below 0.95 accuracy, its query-operation K slope exceeds 0.25, it beats the trace memorizer by less than 0.40 composition accuracy, or it saves less than 70% query operations versus dense scan at K=32 and D=4/6.

outcome_policy.negative: The learned controller fails unseen composition, adversarial symmetry or K-independent access under full accounting; discard this implementation and reduce HYP-0009 confidence without post-result tuning.
outcome_policy.null: Exact composition is matched by the oracle and the hard/dense difference is fully explained by the supplied index; keep the implementation as a control and reduce novelty expectations without claiming the family falsified.
outcome_policy.positive: The controller learned reusable opaque instruction meanings that compose exactly on this pointer micro-world, and hard external access removed irrelevant-K query scans; retain only this bounded mechanism and replicate adversarially before any stronger status.

predicted_outcome: Learned hard, dense and oracle controllers reach exact overall, composition and adversarial accuracy in every quick cell. The whole-trace memorizer remains below 0.50 composition accuracy. Learned-hard query K slope is at most 0.15; dense scan slope is at least 0.75; at K=32 and D=4/6 learned hard uses at least 70% fewer query operations. Learned hard pays nonzero instruction-inference cost and remains dominated by the oracle full-cost bound.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote HYP-0009. A later screen is justified only if all exactness, composition, adversarial and K-scaling gates pass, the candidate adds capability beyond whole-trace memorization, supervision and fit are fully charged, and the result is described only as learned instruction reuse over explicit random-access memory.
research_question: Can a compact controller infer opaque primitive semantics from input-output demonstrations and execute unseen instruction compositions with exact adversarial length extrapolation and memory access independent of irrelevant K, or is the effect only a hand-provided random-access index?
title: Learned opaque instructions on adversarial pointer memory
